profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.
profile.summary:
I am a passionate backend developer at JPMC with hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, and AWS. In my role, I focus on building scalable, high-performance systems that drive meaningful business outcomes. I’m particularly dedicated to delivering quality solutions that improve the user experience, ensuring that every piece of code I write contributes to both the functionality and the end-user satisfaction of our products.

In addition to my technical work, I’ve had the privilege of mentoring new team members, guiding them through onboarding, and helping them grow in their roles. I find great fulfillment in empowering others and fostering a collaborative, growth-oriented team environment.

I am always looking to grow professionally and technically, so please feel free to reach out if you'd like to connect.
